method: Exploratory storage-change/rainfall proxy: positive May-to-November water-level rise times specific yield and area, divided by June-September rainfall volume; median across paired years. Negative changes are clipped to zero
caveat: Net of the season's pumping and other flows, with an assumed specific yield. This is not gross recharge or a measured rainfall-recharge fraction. October-November rain is outside the denominator; a ratio above 100% does not prove imported water.
limits: Depth alone does not identify a confined aquifer. The 20 m exclusion is a project precaution, not a hydrogeological diagnosis; well construction and aquifer data are needed.

In the current snapshot, proxy and depth correlate at 0.27 after the exclusion versus 0.40 before. Compare similar depth and aquifer settings; these descriptive correlations require rechecking when data change.
Rainfall-window mismatch, irrigation return flows, lateral flows, pumping and specific-yield error can all change the ratio. Their contributions are not identified here.

Project thresholds describe the proxy, not validated recharge suitability. Any proposed structure must be verified in the field; agreement with a published recharge coefficient is not independent validation.
